text: Implement default all-complete-cell Jacobian admission at eight corners and center on incremental and accumulated authoritative forward states, retaining existing voxel checks, Jacobian floors, controller and attempt budgets. Cover both HalfFlow-CC and BasinBridge through their shared ForwardGeometry gate. Add export checks for authoritative source and endpoint cells so direct API construction cannot bypass optimizer checks. Preserve frozen MRI studies and historical fields. Validate hidden boundary-cell folds, physical affine grids/handedness, masks/nonfinite support, native parity against all48 captured fields and a new six-case C04 replay with independent cell audits. Full inverse-boundary accuracy remains separately required; no claim of MRI improvement from stronger topology admission.
